2607.26307.title: TraceCoder: Explainable and Auditable Code Generation with Position-Key Snippet Versioning
2607.26307.paper_summary: Contemporary LLM-based coding agents produce code as black-box outputs: the rationale behind each line is hidden, the evolution of the code through benchmark-driven repair is ephemeral, and post-hoc auditing is impossible. We present a code generation concept that addresses these shortcomings through three complementary mechanisms: (i) a relational snippet-history schema that records, per repair event, the benchmark reference, round number, failure text, and LLM explanation, enabling full provenance queries; (ii) a browser-based visualisation tool that renders this history as heat-mapped, hover-annotated source code; and (iii) a competitive fractional position-key indexing scheme with tree-node delimiters that assigns stable, lexicographically-ordered identifiers to each code snippet, enabling fine-grained tracking without disrupting surrounding lines. We evaluate TraceCoder on 30 algorithmic programming tasks spanning string processing, mathematical computation, and data-structure manipulation, across two provider configurations. Of these, 10 exhaust the 6-iteration budget on tasks with subtle edge-case behaviour. Mean Chg% reaches 30%, three in ten code snippets carry a traceable repair-event row, compared to 21% when using Gemini 2.0 Flash as sole provider on a 20-task subset. Three detailed case studies demonstrate how the system explains which specific benchmark failures shaped each line of the final program. The proposed mechanism makes the internal "narrative" of automated code generation auditable and replayable, a property essential for trust and accountability in production deployments.
2607.26307.paper_summary_zh: 當代基於 LLM 的編碼代理生成的代碼是作為黑箱輸出：每一行背後的理由都是隱藏的，通過基準驅動的修復過程中代碼的演變是短暫的，事後審計是不可能的。我們提出了一個代碼生成概念，通過三個互補的機制來解決這些缺陷：（i）一個關聯片段歷史架構，記錄每個修復事件的基準參考、回合號、失敗文本和 LLM 解釋，從而實現完整的來源查詢；（ii）一個基於瀏覽器的可視化工具，將這個歷史呈現為熱圖標註的源代碼；以及（iii）一個具有樹節點分隔符的競爭性分數位置鍵索引方案，為每個代碼片段分配穩定的、按字典順序排列的標識符，實現細粒度的跟蹤而不干擾周圍的行。我們在 30 個算法編程任務上評估了 TraceCoder，這些任務涵蓋了字符串處理、數學計算和數據結構操作，並跨越兩個提供者配置。在這些任務中，有 10 個在具有微妙邊緣情況行為的任務上耗盡了 6 次迭代預算。平均變化百分比達到 30%，三分之一的代碼片段攜帶可追溯的修復事件行，而在僅使用 Gemini 2.0 Flash 作為 20 任務子集的唯一提供者時，這一比例為 21%。三個詳細的案例研究展示了系統如何解釋每一行最終程序是如何受到特定基準失敗的影響。所提出的機制使自動代碼生成的內部“敘事”可審計和可重播，這一特性對於生產部署中的信任和問責至關重要。
